contract: Use the v1 judged BTMisspec K=3, p=2, gamma=1, n=1500, beta=2000 setup.
Run 15 deterministic repetitions and report ranking MSE times 100.
Compute separate oracle A-optimal policies for Borda, BT, and Rank Centrality and compare with a budget-matched uniform policy.
Require expected budget error below 1e-6 and A-optimal variance objective no greater than random.
Require A-optimal mean MSE below random for every GARS.
Require all six observed 95% Monte Carlo intervals to overlap the v1 paper intervals.
